The Complete Season Three |publisher=[[Warner Bros.|Warner Home Video]] |release date=*[[October 18]], [[2011]] {{C|US}}{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_set/index.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Season 3 on Blu-Ray and DVD This October}} *[[October 17]], 2011 {{C|UK}}{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=d/DVD-Blu-ray/Star-Wars-Clone-Complete-Season-Three-2011/B004VQPLR6|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars - The Complete Season Three (DVD) (2011)}} |runtime=490 minutes |upc= |isbn= |media type=*Blu-ray disc *DVD |resolution=*1080p (Blu-ray disc) *480p (DVD) |ratio=2.35:1 |audio=English *DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1 |subtitles=English }} '''''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three''' is a three-disc Blu-ray or four-disc DVD set of the [[2010]]–[[2011]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. It was released by [[Warner Bros.|Warner Home Video]] on [[October 18]], 2011. ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three was released in a standard slipcase format, different from the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|first]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|two]] seasons, which received box sets with interior booklets. The remaining series' home-video releases followed the Season Three slipcase format. ==Contents== The set includes: *Behind-The-Scenes featurettes on each disc: **[[Creating Kamino]] **[[Hutts and the Underworld]] **[[Witches and Monsters]] **[[Secrets of Mortis]] **[[Chewbacca Returns]] *The "Jedi Temple Archives" feature exclusive to the Blu-ray disc version. The DVD version includes some hidden [[easter egg]]s: *Disc One—Commentary on [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards by [[Kilian Plunkett]]; *Disc Two—Commentary on [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]]; *Disc Three—Commentary on naming [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] by [[Dave Filoni]]; *Disc Four—Commentary on animation. ==Media== ===Editions=== *UPC 883929153992; [[October 18]], [[2011]]; [[Warner Bros.|Warner Home Video]]; US Blu-ray disc{{BN|url=w/dvd-star-wars-the-clone-wars-the-complete-season-three/22490895|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars - The Complete Season Three}} {{C|Blu-ray}} *UPC 883929154012; October 18, 2011; Warner Home Video; US DVD{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Clone-Season/dp/B004LROMT8|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Season 3}} {{C|DVD}} ===Cover gallery=== File:TCWS3-Bluray.jpg|Blu-ray File:TCWS3-DVD.jpg|DVD ==Sources== *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_set/index.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Season 3 on Blu-ray disc and DVD This October}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{TheCloneWarsEpisodes}} {{Interlang |ka=ვარსკვლავური ომები: კლონების ომები: სრული მესამე სეზონი }} [[Category:Star Wars: The Clone Wars home video releases]]
